metadata.summary: Jitin ordered a medium hot tea with Half & Half from Manhattan Bagel and requested napkins with the order, but the call ended before the order could be successfully placed.

messages.text: Hello Jitin, welcome to Manhattan Bagel. It's great to see you again. What would you like to order?
Yeah. I want to order, hot tea.
The hot tea, excellent choice. Let me get the options for your hot tea...
For your hot tea, we have several options. Let's start with the size. You can choose from Small 12oz, Medium 16oz, Large 20oz, or X Large 24oz. Which size would you prefer?
A medium size hot tea it is. Now, let's talk about the roast. We have House Blend, Vanilla Hazelnut Blend, Dark Roast, Decaf, or Tea. Which one sounds good to you?
For your medium hot tea, you've chosen the Tea option. Next, would you like to add any milk? We have Regular Milk, Half & Half, Skim, Almond, Oat Milk, or Soy. Which one would you like?

You've chosen Half & Half for your medium hot tea. Now, let's consider sweeteners and syrups. We have options like Sugar, Sweet & Low, Equal, Splenda, Raw Sugar, and various syrups such as Pumpkin, Caramel, Hazelnut, and more. Would you like to add any of these to your tea?
No. I think that's all for for the tea. Can you please, submit the order?
Perfect, let me add that to your order...
Added 1 item(s) to your cart. Total: $4.48
Alright, I've added the medium hot tea to your order. Your total comes out to be $4.48. Do you have any special requests or allergies I should note for the kitchen?
No. I don't have any energy. Just make sure, I can if I it will be great if I am having the napkins in the order.
I'll make sure the kitchen knows to include napkins with your order. Alright, let me get this order placed for you...
I apologize, but it seems like there's been an error processing your order. Let me try again. Alright, let me get this order placed for you...
Call ended before tool response was received
